history belongs to the requesting Roblox user, ten edits produce one delayed profile write and only the last sixteen messages are persisted per conversation
no share is created without confirmation; only a filtered textual snapshot is readable by code, the original remains private and repeated sharing is rate limited
filter service failure refuses public sharing and leaves the private conversation intact

greetings and questions avoid outfit generation; a short follow-up retains the help subject and a hair/color refinement preserves the original style
renaming and archiving persist as separate history metadata and a confirmed deletion remains deleted after the delayed storage write
the duplicated feed refresh shown in the server photo is served from the short cache, while a real publication/withdrawal invalidates it immediately
